title: Momentum & Swing Trading
subtitle: Build a rules-based system for identifying momentum setups with documented positive expectancy.
what_you_learn: The academic evidence behind momentum — why it persists and why most retail traders fail to capture it
Identify the 3 highest-probability momentum setups including the bull flag and volume breakout
Set precise entry triggers that separate strong setups from weak ones
Place stop-losses at technically correct levels, not arbitrary dollar amounts
Scale in and out of positions to maximise gains on winners
Build a pre-market routine to find daily setups using Phantom Traders screener
Backtest your rules and calculate your system's true expectancy before risking real money
